## Interpretation (24 September 2026, 21:2x; not registered, read from the tables)

- **Verdict on this family: between.** The beyond-MP2 increment as the composite carries it is −1.9 cm⁻¹ at naphthalene against −6.0 at benzene:
  4.1 cm⁻¹ apart, same sign — above the 2.5 cm⁻¹ win margin, below the 5 cm⁻¹ lose line of §4 of the pre-registration. A benzene increment
  transferred to the C–C stretch of naphthalene would therefore miss the TZ anchor by ≈ 4 cm⁻¹: not licensed at the 2.5 margin. The family stays
  TZ-anchored in the deck, and the measured −1.9 cm⁻¹ enters the error budget as the basis term of decision 26 (as for mode 12).
- **Where the basis step sits:** the composite curvature falls by 47.6 cm⁻¹ from DZ to TZ along this mode; SCF carries −32.1 and full MP2 −13.7 —
  both are the decision-33 basis terms that cost minutes per point at any size. The beyond-MP2 part is −1.9. The DZ-anchored deck is therefore
  not wrong in its structure for this family; it is the transferred correction that is 4 cm⁻¹ off.
- **The mixed form** k(LNO-CC) − k(full MP2) gives +8.1 cm⁻¹ (sign flipped against benzene): as at mode 22 it measures the DZ → TZ growth of the
  LNO-MP2 truncation (LNO-MP2 corr −3.7 vs full MP2 −13.7 cm⁻¹, i.e. ≈ 10 cm⁻¹ of truncation growth), which the composite removes. The composite
  definition carries the verdict; both are printed.
- **Quartic content** of the LNO-CCSD(T) correlation part: c₄/k −1.6 % (DZ), −3.3 % (TZ) — small; the two-point even fit is adequate here (the
  out-of-plane family, 12 % / 6 %, is the one being densified under decision 45).
- **Frequency along the B3LYP mode vector:** composite 1438 (DZ) → 1391 cm⁻¹ (TZ) against B3LYP/6-31G* 1410.

**Tally of probe M3 after three families:** out-of-plane (mode 12) lose, in-plane C–H bend (mode 22) win, C–C stretch (mode 31) between.
Under §4 the probe as a whole is lost (decided at mode 12); per family, one of three is licensed for the DZ-anchored deck.
